response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior/staff-level individual contributor engineer with broad full-stack, distributed-systems, and open-source experience, but he has no executive or senior technical-leadership track record, no experience scaling engineering teams, no demonstrated production multi-agent AI system ownership, and only tangential fintech exposure. The gap between his IC-level career trajectory and the CTO-level strategic, organizational, and AI-architecture leadership required for this role is too large.
strengths: Broad, deep hands-on engineering experience across many languages, stacks, and domains (web, mobile, embedded, distributed systems)
Some exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling in current role at re:cinq
Fintech-adjacent experience at Optilyz and RIDE Capital (pricing systems, investment platform)
concerns: No evidence of leadership experience — no people management, team scaling, or org-building track record at any company

No demonstrated production ownership of multi-agent AI systems at scale; AI-agent work appears recent and tooling-focused rather than architecting agentic decision systems with feedback loops and observability
Career history shows individual-contributor/staff-level roles only; no signal of board communication, governance of outsourced teams, or executive strategic responsibility

key_factors.factor: Lack of engineering leadership/team-scaling track record
No demonstrated production multi-agent AI system experience
Strong general technical breadth and some fintech/AI-agent exposure
